text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a sec... What's with this
place?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We came to the Hanshin J.F. in high
spirits. The
paddocks here are different
than anything we've
seen before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
These Umamusume... are completely
different.
Their bodies look like they're
loaded with springs.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And look at the spectators! The place is
packed...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, this is the G1... This is the Hanshin
J.F., huh?
Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I wanna say I am at least, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I feel really outta place here...
Was this a

mistake?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
None of 'em are here to play. None of
'em are
tryin' to get by with just their
passion, like me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I really compete with them?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know. But I really don't have a good
feelin'
about this...
choice_data_list: Vodka, don't let it swallow you up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter how determined I am, I might
not make
it. If I mess up, I'm gonna look
so lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All... I've got?
choice_data_list: If you give it your all, there's n...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that standing up to your fears
and not
being afraid to lose is another
way to be cool.
choice_data_list: Even if we can't win, let's go out...
Even if we can't win, let's go out...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Being cool is... not backing down from
my fears.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right. Nice one, partner.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The lamest thing I could do is curl up in
fright and
not do anything. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta throw myself straight in!
That's the
coolest thing I can do right
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She regains her composure and nods.
Just like
that, Vodka's back to her
confident self.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right! Get a load of me, you
hard-workin'
prodigies!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You'll never beat me in spirit. You'll
remember
how cool I am well after this is
over!
